First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
An hour or two on the trails; a road or double-track ride if trails are closed.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the CORP CamRock Thursday Group Ride group ride

CORP CamRock Thursday Group Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Cambridge, WI. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from CORP Garage.

CORP Trails' Thursday-evening ride at CamRock MTB Trails in Cambridge, east of Madison. Riders meet at the CORP Garage and head out at 6:00 pm for an hour or two, then hang out around a bonfire. The group says the rides run year-round and are open to all ages, genders and abilities.
